walkthroughs.body_html:
Component 2: Externally Set Assignment — a core area of A-Level Art & Design.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Component 2: Externally Set Assignment brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Component 2: Externally Set Assignment.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: What is the significance of Duchamp's 'Fountain'?
options: It is a study of plumbing.
It demonstrated his sculpting ability.
It challenged the definition of art - the artist's choice, not their skill, becomes the artwork.
Using only blue and green.

mcqs.q: What attitude does Pop Art take toward consumer culture?
options: It rejects all modern imagery.
It straightforwardly celebrates capitalism.
Ambiguous - it both celebrates and critiques mass media imagery.
It is a study of plumbing.

mcqs.q: What is the central innovation of Cubism?
options: It is a study of plumbing.
Showing an object from multiple viewpoints simultaneously on a flat surface.
Using only blue and green.
Painting everything as cubes.
